claims.label: Looney Tunes-style clip's audio is unedited and depicts evasive behavior by Farnsworth
claims.claim: The episode presents that the audio of the Looney Tunes-style clip aired regarding Terrell Farnsworth is unedited and real, with the host asserting the depicted behavior is consistent with prior suspicions.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the aired audio against any independently circulating version; confirm timestamp of original cartoon source.*

claims.label: Judge Graph self-reports 95% of work as sex crimes prosecution
claims.claim: The episode presents Judge Graph stating that approximately 95% of his prosecutorial work has involved sex crimes against children and adults.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the full source clip and verify date / context; cross-check with court biographical records.*

claims.label: Mike Mitchell was an undercover detective specializing in internet sex crimes against children
claims.claim: The episode presents that Mike Mitchell's career was as an undercover detective in internet sex crimes against children, and that he was central in the Tyler Robinson surrender process.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Mike Mitchell's personnel records / Utah County Sheriff's Office assignment history.*

claims.label: Officer Christopher Bagley previously worked child sex crimes at Utah County Sheriff's Office
claims.claim: The episode presents that Bagley formerly worked in child sex crimes at the Utah County Sheriff's Office before transferring to UVU police in approximately 2022.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bagley's personnel record with UVU police / Utah County Sheriff's Office.*

claims.label: George Zinn had child pornography pertaining to a 5-year-old on his phone
claims.claim: The episode presents that following George Zinn's arrest, child pornography pertaining to a 5-year-old was discovered on his phone, and that he was sentenced for child sex crimes.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain New York Post article referenced and court records for George Zinn's case.*

claims.label: Michael George Carl signed the first six search warrants in the Charlie Kirk case
claims.claim: The episode presents that the first six search warrants in the Charlie Kirk case, including on George Zinn, were signed off by Michael George Carl on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the search warrant records from Utah court filings to verify signatory.*

claims.label: Michael George Carl's primary assignment is cyber crimes against youth / SVU
claims.claim: The episode presents that Michael George Carl's documented assignment is the Special Victims Unit / ICAC, focused on online crimes against children.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Carl's Utah County Sheriff's Office / ICAC assignment records.*

claims.label: A Utah ICAC officer took Mikey McCoy's statement on September 10
claims.claim: The episode displays footage and still photographs showing that Mikey McCoy's statement on September 10, 2025 was taken by a female officer wearing a vest reading "Police" and "Utah ICAC."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific officer via Utah ICAC roster; obtain the recorded statement through FOIA / public records request.*

claims.label: ICAC unit is administratively controlled by the Utah Attorney General's Office
claims.claim: The episode asserts that the Utah ICAC works under the Utah Attorney General's Office.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Utah ICAC administrative structure via Utah AG public materials.*

claims.label: The ICAC program was established by the U.S. Department of Justice in 1998
claims.claim: The episode presents that the federal Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force Program was established by the U.S. Department of Justice in 1998.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify DOJ / OJJDP documentation of the 1998 ICAC program founding.*

claims.label: David Leavitt was the subject of an HSI whistleblower allegation regarding trafficking / Indian child welfare violations in 2020
claims.claim: The episode presents that in 2020, an HSI whistleblower alleged that video evidence potentially implicating then-Utah AG David Leavitt in federal trafficking and Indian child welfare violations was received but no investigation was opened.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain HSI whistleblower complaint / DOJ records pertaining to Leavitt.*

claims.label: David Leavitt was named in a 151-page victim statement related to a 1990–2010 ritual child abuse / cannibalism investigation in Utah
claims.claim: The episode presents that Utah AG David Leavitt was named in a 151-page victim statement regarding ritualistic child abuse / cannibalism allegations spanning 1990–2010, which he characterized as politically manufactured.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the May–June 2022 Utah County Sheriff's Office press materials and any related filings.*

claims.label: Matt Tardio pled no contest October 2025 to felony coercion and misdemeanor harassment in an incident captured by surveillance at an ICE facility
claims.claim: The episode presents that Matt Tardio pled no contest in Portland in October 2025 to felony coercion and misdemeanor harassment following an incident at an ICE facility, with surveillance cameras capturing the alleged conduct.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull Portland court records for Matt Tardio's October 2025 plea and related news reports.*

claims.label: Macklemore made a "Free Palestine" speech at an Ed Sheeran tour stop
claims.claim: The episode plays a clip of Macklemore stating "Free Palestine" and other political statements during an opening-act performance on Ed Sheeran's tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific tour stop date and verify the full unedited speech.*

claims.label: Robert Kraft lobbied for Macklemore's removal from the Ed Sheeran tour
claims.claim: The episode presents that Robert Kraft led a lobbying effort that resulted in Macklemore being dropped as an opening act from Ed Sheeran's tour.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate primary reporting on the lobbying / cancellation; verify Kraft's role.*

claims.label: Multiple TPUSA-adjacent individuals and entities share documented connections to trafficking / child sex abuse cases
claims.claim: The episode displays a spreadsheet and host narration enumerating over fifteen individuals / entities linked to TPUSA or Erica Kirk's circle who have documented connections to trafficking, child sex abuse investigations, or related operations.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify each row of the spreadsheet against primary court / news records; document the precise nature of each "connection" (e.g., accusation vs. conviction vs. employment).*

claims.label: Mike Mitchell convinced the Robinson household to turn Tyler Robinson in despite Robinson's denial of murder
claims.claim: The episode presents that Mike Mitchell convinced Matt Robinson's household to call Tyler and persuade him to peacefully surrender, despite Tyler's denial of involvement.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Mitchell's role via investigative reporting and Robinson family statements.*

claims.label: Officer Bagley's body cam footage went off approximately 25 minutes after activation
claims.claim: The episode presents that Bagley's body cam footage stopped approximately 25 minutes after activation.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Bagley's body cam records disclosed in preliminary hearing exhibits.*

claims.label: George Zinn was sentenced for child sex crimes after his arrest on September 10
claims.claim: The episode presents that George Zinn was sentenced for child sex crimes following his arrest in the immediate aftermath of the September 10 event.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull George Zinn's Utah court records for sentencing outcomes.*

claims.label: The episode asserts a pattern of institutional control by federal actors directed at the Charlie Kirk investigation
claims.claim: The host asserts as opinion that the placement of ICAC / SVU personnel throughout the investigation reflects a deliberate federal control mechanism related to Epstein-era networks.
claims.investigative_direction: Treat as framing premise — testable only via underlying placements (already inscribed above).*
